arguments.cmd:
/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c '
set -euo pipefail
cd /root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics
prep=docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p215_round0_preparation01
bind=docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p215_round0_binding01
freeze=papers/215-prefix-drawdown-clock/frozen_round0
mapfile -t pairs < "$prep/FILES.tsv"
[[ ${#pairs[@]} -eq 37 ]]
[[ $(cut -f1 "$prep/FILES.tsv" | sort -u | wc -l) -eq 37 ]]
[[ $(cut -f2 "$prep/FILES.tsv" | sort -u | wc -l) -eq 37 ]]
pair_count=0
payload_bytes=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r source dest; do
  [[ -f "$source" && ! -L "$source" && -f "$freeze/$dest" && ! -L "$freeze/$dest" ]]
  cmp -- "$source" "$freeze/$dest"
  pair_count=$((pair_count + 1))
  payload_bytes=$((payload_bytes + $(stat -c %s -- "$freeze/$dest")))
done < "$prep/FILES.tsv"
[[ $pair_count -eq 37 ]]
[[ $(find "$freeze" -type f -printf . | wc -c) -eq 38 ]]
[[ $(find "$freeze" -type l -printf . | wc -c) -eq 0 ]]
[[ $(find "$freeze" -mindepth 1 ! -type f ! -type d -printf . | wc -c) -eq 0 ]]
diff -u <(cut -f2 "$prep/FILES.tsv" | sort) <(find "$freeze" -type f ! -path "$freeze/SHA256SUMS" -printf "%P\n" | sort)
diff -u <(printf "%s\n" evidence sections sources verification) <(find "$freeze" -mindepth 1 -type d -printf "%P\n" | sort)
[[ $(wc -l < "$freeze/SHA256SUMS") -eq 37 ]]
cmp -- "$freeze/SHA256SUMS" <((cd "$freeze"; while IFS=$'\t' read -r source dest; do sha256sum -- "$dest"; done < "/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/$prep/FILES.tsv"))
(cd "$freeze" && sha256sum -c --strict SHA256SUMS) >/dev/null
sha256sum -c --strict "$bind/INPUTS.sha256" >/dev/null
canonical_hash=$(sha256sum "$freeze/CANONICAL.json" | cut -d " " -f1)
pdf_hash=$(sha256sum "$freeze/main.pdf" | cut -d " " -f1)
manifest_hash=$(sha256sum "$freeze/SHA256SUMS" | cut -d " " -f1)
[[ "$canonical_hash" == d8a654f53890a94736bb03c1aceaee3975cd53580fa5d212b3482f035a5df405 ]]
[[ "$pdf_hash" == 68b00073dda65e211dfb1ff518729df81b5631b0a75301b37cf6d7465e9f6784 ]]
[[ $(stat -c %s "$freeze/CANONICAL.json") -eq 2724478 ]]
[[ $(stat -c %s "$freeze/main.pdf") -eq 200910 ]]
total_bytes=$((payload_bytes + $(stat -c %s "$freeze/SHA256SUMS")))
printf "STATUS=PASS\nPAIR_COUNT=%d\nPAYLOAD_FILE_COUNT=37\nTOTAL_FILE_COUNT=38\nCHILD_DIRECTORY_COUNT=4\nSYMLINK_COUNT=0\nOTHER_NODE_COUNT=0\nMANIFEST_ENTRY_COUNT=37\nPAYLOAD_BYTES=%d\nTOTAL_FILE_BYTES=%d\nMANIFEST_SHA256=%s\nCANONICAL_BYTES=2724478\nCANONICAL_SHA256=%s\nPDF_BYTES=200910\nPDF_SHA256=%s\nINPUTS_POSTCHECK=PASS\n" "$pair_count" "$payload_bytes" "$total_bytes" "$manifest_hash" "$canonical_hash" "$pdf_hash"
'
